answer: Plates follow the state that issued them, not where you live, so because your car has California plates, remove them when you sell. Return them to the California motor vehicle agency within 10 days. We'll give you the plate return receipt, form NW-PLT-1, which shows the car was sold. Also, since you're selling at a North Carolina store, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it, and you should bring the California registration.
